arguments.sql_query:
WITH loop_desc AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
    FROM omop.concept_ancestor
    WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (956874, 932745, 942350) -- furosemide, bumetanide, torsemide
), loop_exposures AS (
    SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date
    FROM omop.drug_exposure de
    JOIN loop_desc ld ON ld.drug_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
), index_loop AS (
    SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
    FROM loop_exposures
    GROUP BY person_id
), k30 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.person_id
    FROM index_loop i
    JOIN omop.measurement m
      ON m.person_id = i.person_id
     AND m.measurement_date >= i.index_date
     AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 31, i.index_date)
     AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (3023103, 46235078, 3005456, 3041354, 3043409, 3040893)
     AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
), low_k30 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.person_id
    FROM index_loop i
    JOIN omop.measurement m
      ON m.person_id = i.person_id
     AND m.measurement_date >= i.index_date
     AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 31, i.index_date)
     AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (3023103, 46235078, 3005456, 3041354, 3043409, 3040893)
     AND m.value_as_number < 3.5
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS new_loop_diuretic_users,
    SUM(CASE WHEN k30.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS users_with_potassium_measured_30d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN low_k30.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS users_with_potassium_lt_3_5_30d,
    CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN low_k30.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS pct_of_all_new_users,
    CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN low_k30.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN k30.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS pct_among_users_with_k_measured
FROM index_loop i
LEFT JOIN k30 ON k30.person_id = i.person_id
LEFT JOIN low_k30 ON low_k30.person_id = i.person_id;

content.text:
Among **102,203 new loop-diuretic users**, **26,203** had potassium **< 3.5 mmol/L within 30 days**.

- Proportion of **all new users**: **25.64%**
- Among users with potassium measured within 30 days: **43.22%**  
  - 60,627 / 102,203 had a potassium measurement within 30 days

Definition used: first observed exposure to furosemide, bumetanide, or torsemide; potassium measurements included serum/plasma and blood potassium LOINC concepts.
